panel: Use exactly the 64-image, one-question-per-image mask-grounded M0 panel. Question and anatomical target determine the mask; labels are never used to select region or model failures. Development panel includes train/validation, not a blind evaluation. Preserve stopped box M0 with 50 images separately.
data: Existing SLAKE train/validation only. Author mask.txt exact anatomical grayscale codes with aligned dimensions; reject overlays, disease labels, ambiguous singular bilateral targets and invalid geometry. No test labels or images.
views: Current full RGB image longest side512 in every condition. N has no extra view. D adds the whole current image on a336x336 canvas. O adds a raw-image crop from the known anatomical mask bbox plus15% margin, on the same336x336 canvas. W adds an equal-native-size crop with <=5% of target bbox covered and <=.1 crop IoU with O. No mask pixels, boxes, names, source cases, answers or procedures are rendered. D/O/W use identical neutral text, prompt IDs and grids.
metric: Original normalized exact match. Primary O-N and O-D, paired image bootstrap10000 after averaging repeats. Two initializations are inference reproducibility, not independent training seeds. Report every failure, improvement, harm, target and task group.
investment_gate: O-N and O-D each >=.10 with strictly positive image-cluster95% lower bounds and positive means in each repeat; O-W positive overall/nonnegative in each repeat; stable gains represented in at least two named targets. Otherwise close this exact oracle-local-view configuration; choose a separately justified next hypothesis within the unchanged12h window rather than lowering its gate or blindly training a locator.
public_boundary: Only protocol, source and numeric evidence; never raw medical QA/gold, masks/images/crops, raw responses, complete prompts, features, private paths or run tokens.
